message.content: {"Danny O'Brien": ["Flags create a fenced-off hardware world preventing internet distribution and open-source development.", "Government mandates in user tech cross a Rubicon, leading to endless demands for more control.", "FCC standards for broadcast/reception are valid, but regulating post-reception use is a huge overreach.", "EFF successfully challenged initial regulation as agency overreach, but now fights against industry groups trying to extend FCC powers via law."]}
